root_cause.text: Use of timer_delete() (non-synchronous) instead of timer_delete_sync() in mwifiex_adapter_cleanup() allows a race condition where the wakeup_timer callback (wakeup_timer_fn) may still be executing after the timer is deleted, leading to use-after-free when it accesses adapter fields that are subsequently freed.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message explains that timer_delete() does not wait for a running timer callback to complete, so the callback can continue to access adapter->hw_status, adapter->if_ops.card_reset, etc. after the adapter is freed by mwifiex_free_adapter(). The patch changes `timer_delete(&adapter->wakeup_timer)` to `timer_delete_sync(&adapter->wakeup_timer)` in drivers/net/wireless/marvell/mwifiex/init.c.

intent_record.intent_summary: Replace non-synchronous timer deletion with synchronous deletion to prevent a race condition where the timer callback could run after adapter cleanup begins.
intent_record.how: The change ensures that when cleaning up the adapter, the wakeup timer is not only deactivated but also any concurrently executing timer callback is waited for to complete before proceeding, providing proper synchronization.
